import sys, json, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import controller, planlib, probability, valid

def chainy(J=512,S=256,F=32,tg=8,seed=17):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    times=[i*3 for i in range(S)]
    slots=[[times[i], 1, 0] for i in range(S)]
    flows=[[tg, 512, -1, rng.randint(0,6)] for f in range(F)]
    wins=[[rng.randint(0,F-1), 0, times[-1], rng.randint(1,65535), rng.randint(1,320),
           rng.randint(0,20000), rng.randint(1,1000), [[rng.randint(0,1500),rng.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)]] for j in range(J)]
    return {'model':'cnn','class_values':[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],
            'stats':[13,29,75],'bucket':[512,256],'slots':slots,'flows':flows,'groups':[],'windows':wins}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    c = chainy()
    case = valid.validate(valid.parse(json.dumps({'version':3,'cases':[c]}).encode()))[0]
    preds = controller._predict(case['model'], case['windows'], case['flows'])
    thr = probability.window_thresholds(case['stats'], case['windows'])
    W = 1+len(case['windows'])*case['slots'][-1][0]
    value=[case['windows'][j][6]*case['class_values'][preds[j]] for j in range(len(case['windows']))]
    ep = planlib.Plan(case['bucket'],case['slots'],case['flows'],case['groups'],case['windows'],preds,thr,value,W)
    t=time.time(); ep.build_arcs(); ep.build_aux(); print('build %.2f'%(time.time()-t), 'arcs', ep.narcs, 'pairs', len(ep.pairs))
    t=time.time(); idx=ep.ratio_search(); print('ratio_search %.2f'%(time.time()-t), ep.rset[idx], 'candidates', len(ep.rset))
    low=ep.lowers(ep.rset[idx]); ep.set_lowers(low)
    t=time.time(); ep.optimise(low); print('optimise %.2f'%(time.time()-t))
    t=time.time(); ep.potentials(low); print('potentials %.2f'%(time.time()-t))
    t=time.time(); cut=ep.cut_for(idx) if ep.rset[idx]<1 else None; print('cut %.2f'%(time.time()-t))
    t=time.time(); print('verify', ep.verify(ep.rset[idx], low, cut), '%.2f'%(time.time()-t))
PYEOF
